obligations.expected_behavior: The authoring standard enforces a strict maximum of fewer than 500 logical lines in SKILL.md.
forbidden_result: A SKILL.md with 500 or more logical lines passes the gate.
obligations.observable_result: A 499-line SKILL.md passes; 500-line and 501-line SKILL.md files fail.
obligations.state_after: The fewer-than-500 logical-line gate is applied to SKILL.md.
obligations.state_before: SKILL.md may have any logical-line count and is not yet evaluated by this boundary.
obligations.subject: SKILL.md logical-line gate
obligations.trigger: When SKILL.md is evaluated against the authoring standard.

obligations.expected_behavior: The logical-line count includes frontmatter, blank lines, and code blocks.
forbidden_result: Frontmatter, blank lines, or code blocks are excluded from the logical-line count.
obligations.observable_result: The reported logical-line count includes every frontmatter line, blank line, and code-block line.
obligations.state_after: All specified SKILL.md line categories contribute to the logical-line count.
obligations.state_before: The counting scope is not yet established.
obligations.subject: SKILL.md logical-line counting scope

obligations.expected_behavior: The standard recommends keeping the main SKILL.md file smaller than the hard boundary while providing only one hard gate.
forbidden_result: A second hard gate is introduced for main-file size.
obligations.observable_result: The guidance contains a smaller-main-file recommendation, and enforcement has no additional hard gate beyond fewer than 500 logical lines.
obligations.state_after: A smaller main file is recommended without adding a second hard gate.
obligations.state_before: No such recommendation or single-gate constraint is established.
obligations.subject: SKILL.md size guidance
obligations.trigger: When defining or applying the SKILL.md size standard.

obligations.expected_behavior: Logical-line counting produces the same count for equivalent SKILL.md content encoded with LF or CRLF line endings.
forbidden_result: LF and CRLF encodings produce different logical-line counts for equivalent content.
obligations.observable_result: Equivalent LF and CRLF files receive identical logical-line counts and the same pass/fail result.
obligations.state_after: Line-ending style does not affect the logical-line count.
obligations.subject: Line-ending count invariance
obligations.trigger: When counting logical lines in LF- or CRLF-encoded SKILL.md files.

obligations.expected_behavior: A final newline does not count as an additional logical line.
forbidden_result: Adding a final newline changes the logical-line count by one.
obligations.observable_result: The same SKILL.md content has the same logical-line count whether or not it ends with a final newline.
obligations.state_after: Final-newline presence does not alter the logical-line count.
obligations.subject: Final-newline count behavior
obligations.trigger: When counting logical lines in SKILL.md.
